name: guardrails
description: Safety and review of Claude's output. Mods: blast-radius, secret-sentry, reflect (/reflect-queue, /reflect-pause), assumption-tracker (/assumptions), self-critique (/critique), prompt-coach (/sharpen), merge-sweep.

blastRadius.title: blast-radius
blastRadius.description: Asks before destructive shell commands run

secretSentry.title: secret-sentry
secretSentry.description: Blocks API keys and private keys from being written into files

reflect.title: reflect
reflect.description: Spots corrections in your prompts and saves them as rules in CLAUDE.md

assumptionTracker.title: assumption-tracker
assumptionTracker.description: Lists the assumptions Claude made and sends fixes for the ones you mark wrong

selfCritique.title: self-critique
selfCritique.description: /critique panel that reviews Claude's last answer, with one-click fixes

promptCoach.title: prompt-coach
promptCoach.description: Rewrites your first prompt into a better one that makes Claude ask you the open questions first

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: theme follows your Claude Code theme (light, dark, colour-blind); pastel is fixed colours tuned for dark terminals

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: Animate the busy rails while a critique or prompt rewrite runs, or keep them still

mergeSweep.title: merge-sweep
mergeSweep.description: Offers to clean up branches and worktrees once a PR created in the session is merged
